result.topic_en: Riemann tests whether the law of exponents for generalized derivatives, $\partial_x^\nu \partial_x^\mu z = \partial_x^{\nu+\mu} z$, can hold, by expanding $z(x+h+k)$ in two ways: as a double series in increments $h$ and $k$, and as a single series in $h+k$.

Single expansion in powers of (h+k), re-expanded via a generalized binomial theorem (formula (3))
Resulting double series with coefficient c_{μ+ν} times the (μ+ν)-th generalized derivative
